elements.text: My finding is a tension, not a verdict against numbers. Feedback can help players act and care. It can also privilege measurable outcomes. DDLC and The Stanley Parable help expose authority at the level of controls; Project Perfect locates it in the classification of colleagues. [4–7]

it in the classification of colleagues. [4–7]

elements.text: The returning title and worn room reopen the question. I want Greg to remain more than the category on his record. Players may optimise without accepting the company’s values, or distrust its indicators immediately. The design invites that disagreement rather than resolving it for them.
